title: AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer (React + Node.js)
description:
Mirko Solutions is an international IT company specializing in web and mobile development for clients across the US, Canada, EU, and Australia. We are looking for an AI-Native Full-Stack Engineer who leverages AI as a core part of the software development lifecycle rather than just a coding assistant. In this role, you will build scalable web applications, rapidly prototype new ideas, integrate AI capabilities into products, and contribute to delivering innovative AI-first solutions.

 

Job Requirements:

  • 4+ years of commercial experience as a Full-Stack Software Engineer
  • Strong knowledge of React (Next.js is a plus)
  • Strong experience with Node.js (NestJS and/or Express)
  • Proficiency in TypeScript
  • Experience working with PostgreSQL or other SQL databases
  • Solid understanding of REST API design and integration
  • Experience deploying applications using Vercel, Railway, Supabase, Render, AWS, or GCP
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work independently
  • Excellent communication skills in English
  • Daily use of AI development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, or similar
  • Experience using AI for:
    • Code generation
    • Debugging and troubleshooting
    • Refactoring existing code
    • Rapid MVP development
    • Test generation
    • Documentation creation
  • Strong understanding of AI-first development workflows
  • Ability to effectively validate and review AI-generated code 
  • LLM & AI Integration Experience

 

Nice-to-Have:

  • Experience with LangGraph
  • Experience with Model Context Protocol (MCP)
  • Experience using n8n
  • Experience with Supabase
  • Experience with Vercel AI SDK
  • Experience working with Vector Databases
  • Docker
  • AWS

 

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain modern full-stack web applications
  • Build new product features using React, Node.js, and TypeScript
  • Rapidly prototype and deliver MVPs using AI-assisted development workflows
  • Integrate LLMs and AI services into production applications
  • Build AI-powered features such as intelligent search, recommendations, document processing, and conversational experiences
  • Develop and maintain REST APIs and backend services
  • Work with SQL databases and optimize application performance
  • Review, validate, and improve AI-generated code to ensure production quality
  • Collaborate closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other Engineers
  • Continuously improve development processes through AI-native engineering practices

 

We provide the following for our employees:

  • Competitive salary according to qualification
  • Comfortable working environment
  • Experienced colleagues
  • Opportunity to work with innovative AI-driven projects
  • Regular performance reviews
  • Friendly atmosphere and support for professional growth
